Title: Preview update: Azure Cosmos DB protocol support for MongoDB

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB accounts with protocol support for MongoDB are now available in all Azure Cosmos DB Azure regions.  Read more about Azure Cosmos DB protocol support for MongoDB, and be sure to try it out for yourself by creating an account. 

For more information about Azure Cosmos DB, visit the Azure Cosmos DB page.
